$comment: Approved dependency allowlist. A submission may only request packages listed here for its runtime. `baked: true` means the runtime image already contains it (offline, no network needed). `baked: false` marks a package that is approved in principle but not yet baked into the image — a controlled package mirror must supply it before it can run. This is the policy half of 'dependency allowlists or controlled package mirrors' (design 3.3/3.5).
